decisions_required.boundary: Four-backtick opener versus three-backtick candidate closer needs an explicit supported grammar; do not assume parity is sufficient.
Whether an unmatched quotation in a colon-labelled actor turn carries into the next turn is not yet specified.
An inch mark or literal quote symbol in prose cannot be semantically distinguished by a raw quote counter without a declared syntax policy.

A caller-designated actual transcript formatted in a fence or actual stage directions are not intrinsically hypothetical. Structural E means embedded/unresolved for this path, not that speech never occurred.
